description: Default practitioner profile for Utah district-court complaints. Copy and edit per firm or matter (signature block, checkpoint mode, jury, review requirements).

drafting.jury_demand_note: Endorsed on the complaint under URCP 38(b). The jury fee is charged when the demand is filed; see the civil cover sheet. Attorney may turn this off per matter.

rules_pack.currency: MANUAL — the attorney confirms the rules and statutes are current before filing. This skill does not check for updates.

approved_tools.note: Client-confidential facts go only into tools the firm has approved.

scope_exclusions: Conflicts clearance is handled outside this skill.
Limitations analysis is handled outside this skill.
